copy.curiosityHook: What drives modern gleaners across fields and urban stalls to recover what society routinely abandons?
copy.description: Director Agnès Varda travels from rural French fields to Parisian green markets, documenting gleaners who salvage discarded produce and forgotten objects out of necessity or activism.
copy.vibeSummary: Thoughtful, deliberate, and grounded; an engaged French documentary that rewards patient solo viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Varda turns an intimate, wandering documentary inquiry into an observant meditation on waste, resourcefulness, and the varied lives making purpose out of what others leave behind.

allowedMaterial: Subject matter of gleaners recovering cast-off food and objects
Travel from French countryside fields to Paris markets
Motivations spanning necessity, salvage, and activism
excludedMaterial: Specific late-documentary encounters or character resolutions
